# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

The instructions for this repository are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repo root, shared by every coding agent so that there is one copy. Read it
before you change anything. `README.md` says how the app is built.

Its "Rules" are the owner's and are not optional: merging to `main` deploys to
staging, production and deletions need the owner, merge only when every check
has passed, never print a token.

Do not add project knowledge to this file. Put it in `AGENTS.md` or
`README.md`, in the same pull request as the change it describes.
